text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn (Erythroblastosis Fetalis). The infant's Rh-positive blood type combined with the mother's Rh-negative status indicates an Rh incompatibility, confirmed by the elevated total bilirubin level (7 mg/dL) with a normal direct bilirubin, which is characteristic of hemolysis.
